title: Gujarat Launches ₹2.94 Crore Plastic Waste Management Project at Nalsarovar

blocks.content: The Gujarat Forest Department launched a ₹2.94 crore Plastic Waste Management Project around the Ramsar-designated Nalsarovar Bird Sanctuary on 11 August 2026. The project is linked to the Project for Eco-Restoration in Gujarat and has financial support from the Japan International Cooperation Agency. It aims to buy plastic waste from villagers, support local livelihoods, and reduce plastic pollution in the sanctuary area.

items: Ramsar sites are wetlands protected under the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands, which was adopted in 1971.
Eco-Development Committees are community-based bodies used in wildlife and forest management in India.
JICA stands for Japan International Cooperation Agency, which provides development assistance and project funding.
Gujarat has several wetland and bird sanctuary sites that are important for migratory birds and biodiversity.
